SELECT * FROM tb_file f WHERE f.status = 'rejected' OR (f.status = 'pending' AND f.created_at < #{pendingThreshold}) OR ( f.status = 'active' AND f.type != 'enroll-form' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_user u WHERE u.avatar_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_user u WHERE u.qrcode_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_enroll e WHERE e.avatar_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_achievement a WHERE a.file_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_assessment_question aq WHERE aq.attachment_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_assessment_answer aa WHERE aa.file_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_qrcode q WHERE q.file_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_competition c WHERE c.logo_file_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_competition c WHERE c.cover_file_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_venue v WHERE v.image_file_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_equipment eq WHERE eq.image_file_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_bug_report_image br WHERE br.file_id = f.id) )
